body: Focused-review addendum for REQUIRED (2): do not satisfy the invariant by merely clearing providerCalls/embeddingReceipts in addResultDecisions after a provider actually ran. That would turn a real keyed call into a call-free Withheld history and erase provenance. Withheld must be pre-delegation only. Post-call result-decision re-receipting must reuse an owned key snapshot (or return a typed failure through a signature that can represent it), never manufacture call-free provenance. I will include this semantic check in the refreshed-SHA reread.
